desc: Nightstick's TWM-30-GL Tactical Weapon-Mounted Light with daylight-visible green laser features a 1200-lumen LED with a 228-meter beam distance. Optimized for threat identification and target discrimination, its clearly defined halo provides peripheral illumination in CQB situations. This weapon light features a newly designed bezel that houses both weapon light reflector and green laser, making the TWM-30-GL compatible with all holsters on the market that Nightstick TWM-850XL and TWM-30 lights fit.
